steps.source: let log="";function make(tag:string){class P{tag:string=tag;constructor(v:string){log+=tag;}}return(v:any)=>{const p:P=v;return p;};}const a=make("a");const b=make("b");function choose(flag:boolean){if(flag)return a("x");return b("x");}choose(true).tag+choose(false).tag+choose(true).tag+"/"+log;

cases.name: nested block and concise forwarding preserve selected dependency

steps.source: let log="";function make(tag:string){class P{tag:string=tag;constructor(v:string){log+=tag;}}return(v:any)=>{const p:P=v;return p;};}const a=make("a");const b=make("b");function choose(flag:boolean){if(flag)return a("x");return b("x");}function middle(flag:boolean){return choose(flag);}const outer=(flag:boolean)=>middle(flag);outer(true).tag+outer(false).tag+"/"+log;

cases.name: nested arguments cannot replace the result dependency

steps.source: let log="";function make(tag:string){class P{tag:string=tag;constructor(v:string){log+=tag;}}return(v:any)=>{const p:P=v;return p;};}const a=make("a");const b=make("b");function use(flag:boolean,n:number){if(n>0)return use(flag,n-1);if(flag)return a("x");return b("x");}use(true,3).tag+use(false,2).tag+"/"+log;

cases.name: reentry at an argument preserves the outer contribution

steps.source: let log="";function make(tag:string){class P{tag:string=tag;constructor(v:string){log+=tag;}}return(v:any)=>{const p:P=v;return p;};}const a=make("a");const b=make("b");function use(flag:boolean,n:number){if(flag)return a(n>0?use(false,0).tag:"x");return b("x");}use(true,1).tag+"/"+log;

steps.source: let log="";function make(tag:string){class P{tag:string=tag;constructor(v:string){log+=tag;}}return(v:any)=>{const p:P=v;return p;};}const a=make("a");const b=make("b");function use(flag:boolean){const bad:any=12;try{if(flag)return a(bad);return a("x");}catch(e){return b("x");}}use(true).tag+use(false).tag+"/"+log;

steps.source: let log="";function make(tag:string){class P{tag:string=tag;constructor(v:string){log+=tag;}}return(v:any)=>{const p:P=v;return p;};}const a=make("a");const b=make("b");function use(flag:boolean){if(flag)return local("x");const local=make("c");return local("x");}let caught="";try{use(true);}catch(e){caught=String(e instanceof ReferenceError);}caught+use(false).tag+"/"+log;
